answer: Flooding registration pushes an hostile operator to the back of the ledge queue while honest participants promoted earlier continues earning. The karst index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 490 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the forge. That is 29 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
